title: Chunking and document structure
subtitle: Treat chunking as an information boundary, not a magic constant.
goal: Choose the unit of information that search can find
intro: A chunk is the passage you make independently retrievable; its boundaries affect what the model can understand.
terms: Search small pieces then recover larger context
flow: Enough context to interpret the rule
case: A return rule ends with an exception in the next sentence.
Search should not return a misleading half-rule.
A perfectly relevant fragment may omit the condition that changes the answer.
